brief: Distinguish an insurance protection feature from an investment projection in a combined offer.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Protection Projections"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Separa protección de cifras futuras"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Separe proteção de valores futuros"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Distinguish an insurance protection feature from an investment projection in a combined offer.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Combined offers show contractual protection and uncertain future values; read each on its own terms.
instruction.misconception: An illustrated investment value is the same promise as a contractual insurance benefit.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Separate the contractual covered benefit from projected investment values. Projections depend on assumptions; check fees, conditions and access separately.
The account estimate depends on assumptions about future returns.
The missing protection terms prevent assessing the insurance benefit.
The stated account value varies with its underlying assumptions.
A projected balance does not establish accessible withdrawal proceeds.
A larger account projection does not establish a broader covered benefit.
The covered benefit and growth estimate rest on different terms.
